arabic text: Be-Rida Bint-e-Ali, Jeri Nazaan Di Pali.
english translation text: Bareheaded was Ali's daughter, she who had been raised in tenderness.

arabic text: Pa Ke Hath Kariyaan Jadaan Sham De Bazar Aayi.\nDadhi Majboor Te Be-Chain Si Zahra(SA) Jayi.\nAakhay Sajad(AS) Phophi Bheer Bazaar Bari Tu Aye Nazaan Di Pali.
english translation text: When she entered Shaam's marketplace wearing handcuffs,\nthe descendant of Zahra was helpless and restless.\nSajjad said: Aunt, the marketplace is crowded—you were raised in tenderness.

arabic text: Jainkoon Farmaya Nabi Pak(SAWW) Ne Dill Da Tukra.\nHaye Afsoos Maidi Sainr Koon Haq Na Miliya.\nOh Jadaan Khali Wali Qabar Babe Di Hali Haye Nazaan Di Pali.
english translation text: The Pure Prophet had called her a piece of his heart.\nAlas, my lady was not given her right.\nWhen she returned from her father's empty grave—she who was raised in tenderness.

arabic text:
Chadraan Lutiyaan Te Khaime V Jalaye Lokaan.
Fatima(SA) Jaiyaan Koon Bazaar Wikhaye Lokaan.
Shehar Te Shehar Phiri Rul Gayi Aal-e-Nabi(SAWW) Jairi Nazaan
Di Pali.
english translation text:
Their chadars were looted and their tents
burned. The descendants of Fatima were displayed
in marketplaces. The Prophet's family wandered from city
to city—she who was raised in tenderness.

arabic text: Veer Ghazi(AS) Da Jaddaan Dhal Giya Sir Taun Saya.\nSainr Zainab(SA) Te Kadi Sukh Da Na Waila Aaya.\nKadi Kofe Te Kadi Sham Darbar Gayi Haye Nazaan Di Pali.
english translation text: When the shade of Ghazi her brother left her head,\nZainab never again received a moment of peace.\nAt times Kufa, at times Shaam—she entered the court, she who was raised in tenderness.

arabic text:
Veer Sajjad(AS) Dukh Bhain Koon Chad Chad Na Jawein.
Bhain Ujari Nu Kafan Sham Da Tu Na Pawein.
Kar Ke Matam Aye Chali Wich Zindaan Aye Mari Jairi Nazaan Di
Pali.
english translation text:
Brother Sajjad, do not leave your sister again
and again. Do not give your devastated sister
a shroud from Shaam. Performing matam, she entered
prison and died—she who was raised in tenderness.

arabic text:
Cha Ke Hathaan Te Sakina(SA) Koon Aye Abid(AS) Soche.
Kon Sunrda Aye Meri Kis Nu Dasawaan Ja Ke.
Char Salaan Di Dukhi Bhainr Mar Gayi Aye Meri Jairi Nazaan Di
Pali.
english translation text:
Abid lifted Sakina in his hands and
thought: who will hear me, and whom
can I tell? My four-year-old grieving sister
has died—she who was raised in tenderness.
